_: Contenu de la page Accessibility. Les faits portent sur CE site : ratios de contraste calculés depuis les couleurs de la charte (script du 31 août 2026, pire paire 5,65:1 arrondie vers le bas), navigation :target sans script, details natifs, garde prefers-reduced-motion présente dans les deux bâtisseurs. La dernière section refuse de certifier ce qui n'a pas été audité — c'est le registre de la maison.
titre: Two ways in, one arrival. Measured, not promised.
lede: This page holds the site to the same rule as the product: nothing promised, only measured. The figures below are computed from this site's own stylesheet and structure — and each claim ends with the gesture that lets you check it, right now, on the page you are reading.

sections.h2: The keyboard is a first-class door
html: Every finding on the main screen is a plain address — a link to an anchor. The whole instrument navigates by keyboard alone: Tab reaches every control, Enter opens it, and the browser's back button walks your trail backwards, because each state you visit is a real place in the address bar.
The one small script on that screen only synchronises the animation clock and the tab title. Switch JavaScript off and every state still opens — the navigation is the address, not a handler.
Try it now: press Tab until the findings rail takes focus, then Enter. Then press Back.

Computed from this site's own palette, not asserted: body ink on this paper measures 11.1:1. The weakest text pairing anywhere on the site measures 5.6:1. The accessibility floor for body text is 4.5:1 — every pairing here clears it with room to spare.
And colour never carries a meaning alone: wherever the green marks something — a shackle, a plateau, a signature — a word or a shape carries the same meaning beside it.

The sections of every appendix are native disclosure elements — the browser provides the keyboard behaviour and the screen‑reader semantics, so there is no script of ours to get them wrong. Focus is always visible: every interactive element carries a focus ring drawn in the site's own ink, never suppressed.
Try it now: Tab through this very page — each section header announces itself and toggles with Enter or Space.
Every transition on this site sits behind the reduced‑motion media query. When your system asks for less motion, the cascade holds still — the same figures, the same states, without the movement.
Try it now: switch on your system's Reduce Motion setting and reload — the page arrives already settled.

sections.h2: What this page does not claim
html: These claims are mechanical — ratios computed, anchors counted, media queries present — so we make them. What we do not certify is the lived experience: this site has not been through an audit by a person who uses a screen reader daily, and that is the only audit of that experience that counts. If your team runs one and finds a fault, it will be fixed and this page will say it was.
